newsitem.title: USA: Vail Resorts '96-'97 skier days increase.
newsitem.headline: Vail Resorts '96-'97 skier days increase.

text.p: Vail Resorts Inc said Wednesday its Colorado mountain resorts posted record skier days for the 1996-1997 ski season.

Vail said its four resorts reported a combined 4,877,593 skier days for the year, a five percent increase over the 4,643,777 skier days in the 1995-96 season. One skier day equals one guest accessing a ski mountain on any one day.
Vail operates the Colorado mountain resorts of Vail, Beaver Creek, Breckenridge and Keystone.
